stem:
Priya connects one cell, a switch and a lamp in a single closed loop on her table. The switch is open, so the lamp does not glow.
She wants to record her circuit as a circuit diagram in her notebook.
Which circuit diagram correctly represents Priya's actual circuit?

options.text: A diagram showing the cell, an open switch and the lamp connected in a single closed loop using standard symbols
A diagram showing the cell, a closed switch and the lamp connected in a single closed loop using standard symbols
A diagram showing two lamps connected in parallel with the cell and an open switch
A sketch of the table with drawings of the actual cell, switch and lamp as they physically appear

teacher.key_rationale: A circuit diagram uses standard symbols and must faithfully reproduce the actual circuit: one cell, one lamp, and an open switch in a single loop. B wrongly shows the switch closed, C adds a second lamp and parallel branches not present in the actual circuit, and D is a pictorial sketch rather than a circuit diagram. Key is A.
